package positional_adversary

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestIndependentLiteralTokens(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile("cases.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases []struct {
		Branch string
		Input  string
		Value  json.RawMessage
		Errors json.RawMessage
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	n, err := New()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i, c := range cases {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(i), func(t *testing.T) {
			actual, err := n.Normalize(c.Branch, []byte(c.Input))
			expected := c.Value
			if err != nil {
				actual, _ = json.Marshal(err)
				expected = c.Errors
				if len(c.Errors) == 0 {
					t.Fatalf("unexpected refusal: %v", err)
				}
			} else if len(c.Errors) > 0 {
				t.Fatalf("expected refusal, got %s", actual)
			}
			var a, b any
			if err := json.Unmarshal(actual, &a); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(expected, &b); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(a, b) {
				t.Fatalf("got %s; want %s", actual, expected)
			}
			fresh, err := n.Normalize("run/~", []byte("[]"))
			if err != nil || string(fresh) != `["",""]` {
				t.Fatalf("fresh call: %s %v", fresh, err)
			}
		})
	}
	actual, err := n.Normalize("record", []byte(`{"number":-0}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var v struct{ Number float64 }
	if err := json.Unmarshal(actual, &v); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !math.Signbit(v.Number) {
		t.Fatalf("lost negative zero: %s", actual)
	}
}

func TestCheckedMetadataFaultAndMissingOperand(t *testing.T) {
	n, err := New()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	at := "/branches/pick~1~0/0/value"
	saved := positionArities[at]
	defer func() { positionArities[at] = saved }()
	for _, arity := range []uint64{0, 3} {
		positionArities[at] = arity
		value, err := n.Normalize("pick/~", []byte(`["a","b"]`))
		expected := Refused{{Pointer: at, Rule: "position_value", Detail: "position encountered a value outside its checked tuple contract"}}
		if value != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(err, expected) {
			t.Fatalf("guard: %s %#v", value, err)
		}
	}
	delete(positionArities, at)
	if _, err := n.Normalize("pick/~", []byte(`["a","b"]`)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing arity admitted")
	}
	count := 0
	operand := func(scope, string) (any, error) { count++; return missing, nil }
	value, err := positionValue(operand, ^uint64(0))(scope{}, "/missing-proof")
	if err != nil || !isMissing(value) || count != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("missing propagation: %#v %v %d", value, err, count)
	}
}

func TestInvalidUtf8KindsAndRetainedOrder(t *testing.T) {
	n, err := New()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, c := range []struct{ input, pointer, rule, detail string }{
		{"[\"\xff\",null]", "/input/0", "input_syntax", "positional string contains invalid Unicode"},
		{"[null,null,{\"\xff\":0}]", "/input/2", "input_syntax", "discarded positional token contains invalid Unicode"},
		{"[{\"\xff\":0},null]", "/input/0", "positional_element_type", "fixed_string_array element must be a string or null"},
	} {
		actual, err := n.Normalize("run/~", []byte(c.input))
		expected := Refused{{Pointer: c.pointer, Rule: c.rule, Detail: c.detail}}
		if actual != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(err, expected) {
			t.Fatalf("UTF-8: %s %#v", actual, err)
		}
	}
	actual, err := n.NormalizeBase64JSON("run/~", "W251bGwsImIiLDFlOTk5XQ==")
	if err != nil || string(actual) != `["","b"]` {
		t.Fatalf("retained: %s %v", actual, err)
	}
	_, err = n.NormalizeBase64JSON("unknown", "!")
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(err, Refused{{Pointer: "/input", Rule: "input_base64", Detail: "expected canonical standard base64"}}) {
		t.Fatalf("base64 order: %#v", err)
	}
}
